findings.title: Skill package contains many files
findings.description: Skill package contains 166 files. Large file counts increase attack surface and may indicate bundled dependencies or unnecessary content.
findings.remediation: Review file inventory and remove unnecessary files.

findings.title: Deeply nested file references detected
findings.description: Skill has file references nested more than 5 levels deep. This could be an attempt to hide malicious content in files that are only loaded under specific conditions.
findings.remediation: Flatten the reference structure or ensure all nested files are safe
